columns.name: project_id
columns.definition: Stable project reference shared by the source extracts

columns.name: asset_id
columns.definition: Canonical asset key from the documented fixture crosswalk

columns.name: project_name
columns.definition: Project name from the Primavera-style schedule extract

columns.name: asset_name
columns.definition: Canonical asset name from the financial asset extract

columns.name: supplier_name
columns.definition: Conformed supplier names or UNRESOLVED when no source mapping exists

columns.name: current_milestone
columns.definition: Explicitly selected workshop activity, not a computed latest milestone

columns.name: milestone_status
columns.definition: Status of the selected activity in the schedule extract

columns.name: purchase_order_status
columns.definition: Sorted distinct status values across the project's purchase orders

columns.name: inspection_status
columns.definition: Worst observed inspection outcome: FAIL, REQUEST_INFO, otherwise PASS

columns.name: committed_cost_cents
columns.definition: Sum of purchase order amounts in integer USD cents, including all order statuses

columns.name: purchase_order_count
columns.definition: Count of source purchase order rows before joining other entities

columns.name: inspection_count
columns.definition: Count of source inspection rows before joining other entities

columns.name: decision_readiness
columns.definition: Context availability or review flag; not engineering or purchase approval

columns.name: source_extracted_at
columns.definition: Oldest known source extraction time in ISO-8601; supplier time is unavailable

columns.name: last_successful_refresh
columns.definition: UTC notebook table-build timestamp in ISO-8601

columns.name: run_id
columns.definition: AIDP job run identifier, or explicit interactive/local validation label
